fclk1_boot.py.source:
"""One-shot SLCR repair: make FCLK1 RUN again before pynq Clocks retunes it.

Fresh boots of this image can leave FPGA1_CLK_CTRL = 0x00000000 (CLKACT=0).
pynq's Clocks setter only rewrites the divider fields, so the clock stays
gated and the cop 40 MHz domain freezes (DMA MM2S never completes while the
control plane on FCLK0 still answers).  This script restores the FSBL-style
running state (IO PLL source, DIV0=7 -> 142.857 MHz, CLKACT=1) so that the
loader's Clocks.fclk1_mhz = 40.0 retune takes effect as it did on the
known-good boots.

Run ON THE BOARD as root:  /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/bin/python3 fclk1_boot.py
"""
import mmap
import os
import struct

SLCR_BASE = 0xF8000000
SLCR_UNLOCK, SLCR_LOCK = 0x08, 0x04
UNLOCK_KEY, LOCK_KEY = 0xDF0D, 0x767B
FPGA1_CLK_CTRL = 0x174
FPGA1_RUNNING_142 = 0x000001C1  # CLKACT=1 | DIV0=7<<6 | SRCSEL=0 (IO PLL)

page = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE")
fd = os.open("/dev/mem", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
mm = mmap.mmap(fd, mmap.PAGESIZE, mmap.MAP_SHARED,
               mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE, offset=SLCR_BASE)

def read_reg(offset):
    mm.seek(offset)
    return struct.unpack("<I", mm.read(4))[0]

def write_reg(offset, value):
    mm.seek(SLCR_UNLOCK)
    mm.write(struct.pack("<I", UNLOCK_KEY))
    mm.seek(offset)
    mm.write(struct.pack("<I", value))
    mm.seek(SLCR_LOCK)
    mm.write(struct.pack("<I", LOCK_KEY))

before = read_reg(FPGA1_CLK_CTRL)
print("FPGA1_CLK_CTRL_before=0x%08x" % before)
if before == FPGA1_RUNNING_142:
    print("already_running_noop")
else:
    write_reg(FPGA1_CLK_CTRL, FPGA1_RUNNING_142)
    after = read_reg(FPGA1_CLK_CTRL)
    print("FPGA1_CLK_CTRL_after=0x%08x" % after)
    print("IN_SPEC=%s" % (after == FPGA1_RUNNING_142))
mm.close()
os.close(fd)

run_board.py.source:
"""Board wrapper: register the embedded pynq device, then run any board script.

pynq 3.1 on this board only populates Device.devices when
pynq.pl_server.embedded_device has been imported explicitly; a bare
`import pynq` leaves the list empty and every Overlay/Clocks call raises
"No Devices Found" on a cold boot.  Importing it here first fixes the
device context for the target script.

Usage (root, venv python):
    python3 run_board.py <script.py> [args...]
"""
import runpy
import sys

import pynq.pl_server.embedded_device  # noqa: F401  (registers EmbeddedDevice)

script = sys.argv[1]
sys.argv = [script] + sys.argv[2:]
runpy.run_path(script, run_name="__main__")

gate_check.py.source:
"""Board gate check without PS-side clock surgery (for the MMCM bitstream).

The 40 MHz cop domain is regenerated on-chip from FCLK1, so the loader's
Clocks.fclk1_mhz dance is unnecessary — and on this image the kernel clock
framework reverts SLCR writes anyway, which trips the loader's post-overlay
readback.  This script does the meaningful parts of prepare_board only:
overlay, cop-domain reset pulse, STATUS first reads, firmware smoke.

Run ON THE BOARD (root, venv) via run_board.py:
    run_board.py gate_check.py <package-root>
"""
import sys
import time

package = sys.argv[1]
sys.path.insert(0, package + "/payload/tools")
import cop_payload_loader as loader  # noqa: E402
from pynq import MMIO, Overlay  # noqa: E402

bit = package + "/payload/pynq_cop_40mhz.bit"

overlay = Overlay(bit, download=True)
print("overlay_loaded=%s" % overlay.is_loaded())
loader.pulse_cop_reset(MMIO, time.sleep)
time.sleep(0.01)
cop = loader.cop_mmio_after_reconfigure(MMIO, loader.BOARD_READY_TOKEN)
values = [cop.read(loader.REG["STATUS"]) for _ in range(20)]
print("status_first_reads=" + ",".join(f"0x{v:08x}" for v in values))
if any(v != loader.STATUS["READY"] for v in values):
    raise loader.LoaderError("COP_NOT_READY: %s" % values)
loader.firmware_smoke(cop, 2.0, time.sleep)
print("GATE_CHECK_PASSED")

sys.argv = ["cop_payload_loader.py"] + sys.argv[2:]

slcr_dump.py.source:
"""Dump SLCR FPGA clock/reset control words via /dev/mem (no pynq needed).

Run ON THE BOARD as root:
    /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/bin/python3 slcr_dump.py
"""
import mmap
import os
import struct

SLCR_BASE = 0xF8000000
REGS = [
    ("FPGA0_CLK_CTRL_0x170", 0x170), ("FPGA1_CLK_CTRL_0x174", 0x174),
    ("FPGA2_CLK_CTRL_0x178", 0x178), ("FPGA3_CLK_CTRL_0x17C", 0x17C),
    ("FPGA0_RST_CTRL_0x240", 0x240), ("FPGA1_RST_CTRL_0x244", 0x244),
    ("FPGA2_RST_CTRL_0x248", 0x248), ("FPGA3_RST_CTRL_0x24C", 0x24C),
    ("IO_PLL_CTRL_0x100", 0x100), ("ARM_PLL_CTRL_0x020", 0x020),
]

page = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE")
fd = os.open("/dev/mem", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
mm = mmap.mmap(fd, page, mmap.MAP_SHARED, mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE,
               offset=SLCR_BASE & ~(page - 1))
mm.seek(SLCR_BASE & (page - 1))
base = SLCR_BASE & (page - 1)
for name, off in REGS:
    mm.seek(base + off)
    raw = mm.read(4)
    print("%s=0x%08x" % (name, struct.unpack("<I", raw)[0]))
mm.close()
os.close(fd)
